# credential issuer

The organization that issued a credential. Functional per credential: one issuer is constitutive of the credential's identity (a different issuer is a different credential, even for the same subject matter).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/credentialIssuer>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:credentialIssuer`  

**Type:** `owl:FunctionalProperty`, `owl:ObjectProperty`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/expertise>
